newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae bid to stop CRV meeting denied.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae bid to stop CRV meeting denied.

text.p: U.S. District Court Judge Harold Greene Tuesday denied a request by Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae) for a temporary restraining order against the Committee to Restore Value (CRV), a Sallie Mae spokeswoman said.

The spokeswoman said Greene "declined at this time to rule" whether any votes taken at a shareholder meeting called by the CRV for May 9 would be advisory or binding to Sallie Mae. The CRV, a shareholder group opposed to the Sallie Mae management, has its own own slate of candidates for a privatized Sallie Mae.

The spokeswoman said the Sallie Mae management is confident that it has a better business plan than that of the CRV and that the management plan will receive shareholder support at a meeting on May 15.

Sallie Mae filed suit last week, arguing that the CRV's proxy materials should have been put through the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) registration process. Sallie Mae said it was seeking "clarification of the nature and date" of the CRV meeting.
